# HTTP API

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-api-docs.ts from packages/contracts. Do not edit by hand. -->

All endpoints live under `/api/v1` on the loopback address and are private unless marked *public*. Private endpoints need the session cookie from pairing; state-changing ones also need an `Origin` header from the repobs origin and the `x-repobs-csrf` header. There are no CORS headers, no file-reading endpoints and no command execution.

| Method | Path | Access | Request | Response | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/health` | public | — | [Health](#health) | Version and monitor state; no paths or private data. |
| POST | `/auth/pair` | public | [PairRequest](#pairrequest) | [AuthSession](#authsession) | Exchange a one-time launcher pairing token for an HttpOnly session cookie. Requires an Origin header. |
| GET | `/auth/session` | session | — | [AuthSession](#authsession) | CSRF token for the current session. |
| POST | `/auth/logout` | session+csrf | — | — | Clear the session cookie. |
| GET | `/snapshot` | session | — | [Snapshot](#snapshot) | Normalized repositories, refs, worktrees, sessions, annotation summaries and PR metadata. |
| GET | `/events` | session | — | [SnapshotDiff](#snapshotdiff) | Server-sent events: `hello` {version}, `diff` (SnapshotDiff), `monitor` (MonitorHealth). Refetch /snapshot on a version gap. |
| GET | `/repositories` | session | — | [Repository[]](#repository) | Registered repositories. |
| POST | `/repositories` | session+csrf | [RegisterRepositoryRequest](#registerrepositoryrequest) | [Repository](#repository) | Register a validated local Git repository (any path inside it). Read-only for the repository. |
| GET | `/repositories/suggestions` | session | — | [RepositorySuggestion[]](#repositorysuggestion) | Unregistered repositories seen in session working directories (no disk indexing). |
| POST | `/repositories/pick-directory` | session+csrf | — | [PickDirectoryResponse](#pickdirectoryresponse) | Show the native folder chooser on this Windows machine (501 elsewhere). |
| POST | `/repositories/reorder` | session+csrf | [ReorderRepositoriesRequest](#reorderrepositoriesrequest) | — | Persist repository order. |
| PATCH | `/repositories/{id}` | session+csrf | [UpdateRepositoryRequest](#updaterepositoryrequest) | — | Rename the dashboard entry. |
| DELETE | `/repositories/{id}` | session+csrf | — | — | Remove from the dashboard only. Never deletes files; annotations are kept. |
| GET | `/repositories/{id}/pull-requests` | session | — | [PullRequest[]](#pullrequest) | Cached open PR metadata (only when the GitHub integration is enabled). |
| POST | `/pull-requests/refresh` | session+csrf | — | — | Refresh PR metadata now (409 while the integration is disabled). |
| GET | `/sessions` | session | — | [AgentSession[]](#agentsession) | Sessions associated with registered repositories (and annotated orphans). |
| GET | `/sessions/{id}` | session | — | [AgentSession](#agentsession) | One session with its annotation. |
| GET | `/sessions/{id}/annotation` | session | — | [SessionAnnotation](#sessionannotation) | Human annotation (or null). |
| PUT | `/sessions/{id}/annotation` | session+csrf | [AnnotationInput](#annotationinput) | [SessionAnnotation](#sessionannotation) | Upsert tags, review state, note, alias and checklist (app-local only). |
| DELETE | `/sessions/{id}/annotation` | session+csrf | — | — | Explicitly delete a session annotation. |
| GET | `/annotations/export` | session | — | [AnnotationExport](#annotationexport) | Download all annotations as sanitized JSON (no transcripts). |
| POST | `/annotations/import` | session+csrf | [AnnotationExport](#annotationexport) | — | Merge an export; newer annotations win. |
| GET | `/settings` | session | — | [Settings](#settings) | App settings. |
| PATCH | `/settings` | session+csrf | [SettingsPatch](#settingspatch) | [Settings](#settings) | Change settings (deep partial). |
| POST | `/rescan` | session+csrf | — | — | Troubleshooting only: full rescan. Normal operation never needs it. |
| GET | `/diagnostics` | session | — | [Diagnostics](#diagnostics) | Redacted adapter, watcher, Git and database health. |
